hard_invariants: groove operates on a copy only
target MIDI remains the original canonical MIDI

event ordering cannot reverse across distinct canonical onsets
all variants from the same work/arrangement inherit one split
every transform is reproducible from template version, parameters and seed
source provenance and rights metadata propagate to every derivative
new audio rendering remains disabled until explicit approval
forbidden_while_render_hold: counting planned renders as completed pairs
